title: Why the next trillion dollar company will be built by one person

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know the next trillion-dollar company might be built by just one person?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: We’re in a new era where solo founders can scale faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s about AI tools that let one person build a global business from their laptop.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: No-code platforms and AI co-pilots are making this possible, like with tools from Zapier or Figma.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This changes everything for entrepreneurs, especially in tech and SaaS.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is speed — one person can now move faster than a whole team used to.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if you’re the next one?

caption_text: Why the next trillion dollar company will be built by one person
